'''Terlyn''' is a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Dark Wars]]. Terlyn was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a [[Terlyn's husband|man]], with whom she had two children. Terlyn's husband was a [[Onderon Royalist|royalist]] member of the [[Council of Lords]], and attempted to assassinate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]]. After his death, Terlyn and her children stayed in the Merchant Quarter. She is one of several individuals who can receive a starport visa from Meetra Surik.

==Biography==
Terlyn lived on Onderon, a Inner rim planet within [[The galaxy/Legends|the Galaxy]]. Terlyn was married to a member of the Council of Lords who supported [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Talia (Onderon)|Talia]] during the [[Onderon Civil War]]. She was also the [[Parent/Legends|parent]] to a [[Terlyn's son|son]] and a [[Terlyn's daughter|daughter]] and lived together with them in [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Onderon. Prior to Meetra Surik's [[Mission to Onderon (Old Sith Wars)|mission to Onderon]], Terlyn's husband attempted to assassinate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]], but was [[Death|killed]] in the process. After her husband's death, Terlyn hoped to leave Onderon with her children. However, due to the ongoing unrest, she was unable to acquire a [[starport visa]]. Terlyn approached [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who passed through the [[Merchant Quarter]] of Iziz, hoping to find one who had a spare open starport visa.<ref name="KOTOR II" />

{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords}}
When attempting to visit Onderon, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|Exile]] Meetra Surik was fired on by Vaklu's forces and crashed on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], one of Onderon's [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Hoping to meet [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kavar]], Surik gained the assistance of the [[Mandalorians (Clan Ordo)|Mandalorians]], and arrived in Iziz with [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]]. When Surik passed through the Merchant Quarter, she met Terlyn. Terlyn explained her plight to Surik. During her time on the planet, Surik came into possession of a open starport visa, and can gift it to Terlyn. If it happens, then, ffter profusely thanking Surik, Terlyn left Iziz with her children.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Terlyn appeared in the [[2004]]<ref name="KOTOR II Date">{{GameSpot|url=star-wars-knights-of-the-old-republic-ii-the-sit|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II - Rise of the Sith Lords''}}</ref> [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'',<ref name="KOTOR II" /> developed by [[Obsidian Entertainment]].<ref name="KOTOR II Date" /> The game was a sequel to the [[2003]]<ref name="KOTOR I Date">{{SW|url=news/kotor-galaxy-of-heroes|text=BioWare and Capital Games on Bringing ''KotOR'' Fan Favorites into ''Galaxy of Heroes''|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'',<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="BioWare">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/games/star-wars-knights-of-the-old-republic|text=Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic|archivedate=20200205212954}}</ref>

The Exile can tell Terlyn to get out of her way when they first meet, resulting in [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points. However, if talked to again, Terlyn will still beg for a starport visa. If she is not given a visa by the time he Exile meets Kavar and leaves Onderon, she does not receive one. On the Exile's return to Onderon, Terlyn does not appear.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
